property_summary: For any call with msg.sender == owner, the reference C allows transfers only to non-zero addresses (reverts on zero address), while the buggy version allows transfers only to the zero address (reverts on non-zero). A fuzzer-chosen non-zero receiver that is an EOA will always accept the transfer, so the reference succeeds and the bug reverts.
change_summary: Replace receiver != address(0) with receiver == address(0), allowing only zero-address transfers.
